Photosynthesis

TypeBiological process

Photosynthesis is a biological process used by plants[1] to convert light energy into chemical energy, which is stored in sugars.

The process takes place in the chloroplasts, where CO2 and water are turned into glucose and oxygen with the help of sunlight.

Light-dependent reactions

  • Light-dependent reactions capture the energy of sunlight and store it in the form of ATP and NADPH.
